note: Silvestri 1914 described the species from the soldier only; Krishna 1963 described its alate for the first time (dealate morphotype, Table 8 with measurements of a single specimen), redescribed the soldier and gave measurements of 20 specimens (Table 9, three columns: holotype / range / mean). Type locality Mamou, Guinea; the morphotype was collected at Mt. Nimba.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Dealate form: head yellowish brown, paler near the fontanelle, the bases of the hairs and setae with pale dots; postclypeus pale yellow; anteclypeus and labrum cream yellow; antennae pale yellowish brown; compound eyes black; pronotum pale yellow; abdominal tergites and sternites cream yellow; legs pale yellow with brown. Head and pronotum densely covered with setae and hairs of various sizes; longitudinal ridge of the fore coxa with 6—8 fine setae and several minute hairs. Head small, its margin broadly rounded behind the compound eyes. Compound eyes large, their margins strongly convex. Ocelli nearly circular, about 0.03 mm from the compound eye. Pronotum saddle-shaped, raised in the middle of the anterior part, but less markedly than in F. coatoni and F. tubifrons; anterior margin wavy, weakly concave in the middle; sides rounded; posterior margin distinctly concave. Measurements (single dealate morphotype, mm): head length (to the lateral mandible base) 0.57; head width 0.79; compound eye diameter 0.23; distance to the lower edge of the compound eye 0.02; ocellus length 0.07; pronotum median length 0.32, greatest length 0.36, width 0.64; hind tibia length 0.75.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head brown to yellowish brown, paler posteriorly; postclypeus darker than the head; anteclypeus with a white spot; labrum yellowish brown; mandibles reddish brown, yellowish brown at the base; antennae pale yellowish brown; pronotum the colour of the posterior head or cream yellow; abdominal tergites, sternites and legs pale yellow. Head with a few setae, the frontal projection with about 8—9 setae; pronotum sparsely covered with a few setae; longitudinal ridge of the fore coxa with 3 short stout setae. Head small; posterior lateral margins broadly rounded; frontal projection distinct, tubular; vertex in lateral view rather straight or slightly concave; frons inclined about 45° towards the anteclypeus. Outer margin of the mandibles nearly straight; lower half of the left mandible with 4 obtuse-rounded teeth. Postmental constriction index 0.56—0.66. Antennae 13-segmented; segment 3 as long as segment 2, segment 4 shorter than segment 3. Anterior margin of the pronotum slightly concave in the middle; sides rounded, receding posteriorly; posterior margin weakly concave or nearly straight. Measurements (holotype / 20 specimens, range / mean, mm): head length (to the lateral mandible base) 1.19/1.28—1.43/1.36; head width 0.87/0.90—0.98/0.94; head height 0.77/0.83—0.86/0.85; left mandible length 0.58/0.56—0.60/0.59; postmentum greatest width 0.26/0.31—0.36/0.33, least width 0.16/0.18—0.21/0.20, length —/0.84—0.98/0.91; pronotum greatest length —/0.34—0.38/0.36, width 0.56/0.53—0.64/0.58; hind tibia length 0.65/0.66—0.75/0.70.
